messages:
maria (Product): Quick sync: we need a final ask on ordering Optimize toolkit work (quantization, batching, caching). Sales wants quant first for cost headlines; eng/ML worried about regressions. Can we agree a RICE-driven sequencing and clear launch gates?

kevin (Eng Runtime): Agree we need to be precise about "quantization" scope. GPU INT8 vs mixed vs CPU fallback = very different efforts. Batching + cache changes mostly infra and safer.

tara (Eng-ML): Strong +1 for staged approach. Build eval harness + customer prompt suites before any wide quant rollout. Canary only.

jonathan (Data): Quick data: ~60% requests <256 tokens. Batching helps heavy throughput customers; prefix caching shows ~16% reuse within 10m for some apps. So impact is highly workload-dependent.

ellie (Customer Success): Customer asks: FinReg wants determinism & audit; StartupZ wants cost wins even with small quality tradeoffs; AdsCo cares about throughput. We can map presets to those needs.

sam (Design): Console suggestion: per-route preset (cost/latency/fidelity) + explicit opt-in for quantized variants with an "expected delta" callout and rollback button.

maria (Product): Proposed high-level split: Release A (infra + UX): prefix caching MVP, batching policy tweaks, console presets. Release B (model & quality): quant eval infra, canaries, quant GA. Use RICE to prioritize items inside Release A.

maria (Product): Quick RICE sketch (ballpark, convert later):
```
Feature, Reach, Impact, Confidence, Effort -> RICE score
Prefix cache (MVP), 25k, 2.0, 0.8, 2 -> 20000
Batching (policy), 120k, 1.4, 0.7, 5 -> 23520
Quant (GPU INT8 canary), 80k, 3.0, 0.5, 8 -> 15000
```

kevin (Eng Runtime): If we do batching+cache together there's shared infra: request coalescing, small KV store. Estimate: KV 3 eng-weeks, batching 4 eng-weeks, 1 SRE for testing. Need budget for storage.

tara (Eng-ML): I'll scope the eval runner (A/B, metrics: perplexity, exact-match on customer prompts, human spot checks). Gate quant GA on per-route no-regression thresholds or explicit customer opt-in.

jessica (Eng): For rollout plan: recommend canary by account tier. Start with StartupZ (willing to take cost/quality tradeoff) for small-scale exposure.

ellie (Customer Success): I'll collect 3 customer prompt sets (StartupZ, FinReg, AdsCo) and upload to secure bucket by Friday. Will annotate legal constraints.

maria (Product): Launch criteria proposals:
- Prefix cache MVP: measurable token reduction on eligible traffic OR >=15% cost reduction for top 5 customers, logging & audit enabled.
- Batching: >=20% throughput uplift under p95 SLO, no p99 regressions for <256 tokens.
- Quant GA: automated eval passing per-customer suites OR signed customer opt-in.

sam (Design): Add UX gates: explicit opt-in toggle + clear reason & rollback path in console; show estimated savings.

maria (Product): Decision: ship Release A (caching+batching+presets) first as "Optimize 0.1". Parallel track: build quant eval infra and run INT8 canaries (Q2->Q3). Owners: kevin+ jessica (runtime), tara (ML), ellie (CS), sam (Design). I'll draft PRD and owners doc.

kevin (Eng Runtime): \ud83d\udc4d no objections

tara (Eng-ML): \ud83d\udc4d

sam (Design): will post mocks in thread by EOD Mon.

ellie (Customer Success): uploading prompts now.
